secrets.name: TEBEX_PUBLIC_TOKEN
secrets.description: RIA ROLEPLAY Tebex headless/public token (Tebex dashboard → Developers → Headless API). Required for checkout to open.

secrets.name: TEBEX_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Tebex plugin API secret (Tebex dashboard → Developers → Plugin API). Used to sync packages and to re-verify payments server-side.

secrets.name: TEBEX_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Tebex webhook secret used to verify the X-Tebex-Signature HMAC on payment notifications.

secrets.name: FIVEM_DELIVERY_WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint on the RIA FiveM server that applies a purchased entitlement. Without it, deliveries are parked as pending for an administrator.
